chunks: A number of our companions, from Ahmad ibn Abi Abdullah, from Ali ibn Ishaq ibn Sa'd, from Yunus, from one of his companions, from Abu Abdullah (peace be upon him)
Regarding the extent of the beard, he (peace be upon him) said: 'Clutch the beard with your hand and trim what remains.'
ai.seo_question: How should a Muslim trim their beard according to Shia jurisprudence?
ai.summary: This hadith from al-Kafi establishes the specific fiqh of 'qadl al-lihya' (trimming the beard) by prescribing a tactile method—grasping the beard to gauge length—thereby distinguishing it from complete shaving. It reflects the Shia scholarly emphasis on maintaining the beard as a sign of masculinity and distinction, while allowing for neatness through trimming the excess rather than removing it entirely.
